items.detail: Research Member since May 2026, advised by Prof. Sarah Ostadabbas. items.title: Abiogenesis
items.summary: A Rust simulation of how life could arise from non-living matter, from a primordial soup to self-copying RNA.
items.detail: A small, plain-language simulation written in Rust with egui, shipped as one self-contained app for macOS, Windows and Linux. Molecules drift in a pool that dries and refills; amino acid chains mutate and recombine; droplets (protocells) form where chains crowd; RNA-like strands build themselves from nucleotides, copy themselves into their complement and compete on fitness. Version 0.3.0 covers stages 1 to 3 of a six-stage roadmap (metrics, cells to complex life and a scenario lab come next). The project page has a live soup, an animation for every stage, a lineage tree and optional synthesized sound effects.

items.title: FocusLock
items.summary: A minimal macOS focus timer that pauses when an LLM program or a social media site takes over.
items.detail: A focus timer for macOS with a watchdog that pauses the clock when LLM programs are running or a browser lands on a filtered site, and emergency exits so it can never lock you in. Designed to be ADHD-friendly. The source is private for now; the project page has a simulator of a session.

items.title: ECG and NYC taxi ML projects
items.summary: Multi-label ECG diagnosis with a segment-shuffle probe, and NYC taxi duration and tip prediction.
items.detail: Two machine learning projects shown on one animated map. The ECG project trains a 1D ResNet on PTB-XL and probes whether it relies on rhythm or beat shape by shuffling segments. The taxi project goes from a baseline to LightGBM and an MLP, with evaluation under temporal shift.

items.title: Himawari
items.summary: A live video wallpaper for macOS that turns into your music: animated album art, retro hi-fi gear and synced lyrics.
items.detail: A macOS menu-bar app that plays any video as your wallpaper and, while a song plays, shows the album's animated cover with hi-fi gear from any era beside it, whose meters follow the real music. Skins are small JSON files you can write yourself, and lyrics are synced from LRCLIB or Apple Music. Built with SwiftUI, AVFoundation, Core Animation and Core Audio process taps, and updates itself from its GitHub releases. The project page is a playable hi-fi deck with optional synthesized sound effects.
